def sieve_of_eratosthenes(n):
    primes = [True for i in range(n+1)]
    p = 2
    while p*p <= n:
        if primes[p]:
            for i in range(p*p, n+1, p):
                primes[i] = False
        p += 1
    return [i for i in range(2, n+1) if primes[i]]

def is_prime(n):
    factors = sieve_of_eratosthenes(n)
    return n not in factors
